card.name: The Ordinary World
card.power: Stasis Loop. Play this to cancel any Quest progression this turn. Narrate why nothing changes.
card.lore: Dysfunction isn't just a state; it's a habit. We normalize the pain until it feels like home.

lines.line: The Ordinary World stasis loop: nothing changes; Dysfunction is habit. Normalize pain – feels like home.

card.name: The Call to Adventure
card.power: Cognitive Dissonance. Increase Quest Die by +1. Force another player to introduce a crisis that ruins their current plans.
card.lore: The universe doesn't knock. It throws a brick. The disruption of the status quo is not a request.

lines.line: The Call to Adventure, Cognitive Dissonance: the universe doesn't knock. It throws a brick. Not a request.

card.name: Refusal of the Call
card.power: Rational Panic. Pause the Quest for one turn. All players must explain why they are too busy/tired/scared to save the world.
card.lore: Fear is realistic self-preservation. Change means death of the current identity. The ego fights to stay small.

lines.line: Refusal of the Call, Rational Panic: too busy, tired, scared to save the world. The ego fights to stay small.

card.name: Meeting the Mentor
card.power: External Hard Drive. Draw 2 cards. Give 1 to another player. Wisdom is useless unless you give it away.
card.lore: The Mentor cannot go with you. They provide the map, not the legs. If they stay too long, they become a crutch.

lines.line: Meeting the Mentor, External Hard Drive: wisdom is useless unless you give it away. The map, not the legs.

card.name: Crossing the Threshold
card.power: Point of No Return. Move Quest Die +2. Discard your hand and draw 3 new cards. The old self is dead.
card.lore: Commitment is the moment fear becomes movement. You can't un-take the pill.

lines.line: Crossing the Threshold: hand new cards, old self dead. Fear becomes movement. You can't un-fluff the pill.

card.name: Belly of the Whale
card.power: Digestion. All players discard 1 card. No Quest progress this turn. Next turn, progress is doubled.
card.lore: Liminal space. No longer who you were, not yet who you'll become. Transformation requires dissolution.

lines.line: Belly of the Whale, Digestion: liminal space. No longer who you were, not yet who you'll become.

card.name: Road of Trials
card.power: Grindset. Narrate 3 small problems. For each one you 'solve' in the story, draw 1 card.
card.lore: Recovery is practice. The hero who survives the trials is not the same animal who started them.

lines.line: Road of Trials grindset: recovery is practice; the hero who survives is not the same animal.

card.name: Meeting the Goddess
card.power: Self-Love Bomb. Narrate a moment of acceptance. Quest Die +1 for every player who nods in agreement.
card.lore: The experience of being fully seen. The internal integration of the anima. Bliss is a valid game state.

lines.line: Meeting the Goddess, Self-Love Bomb: a moment of acceptance, being fully seen. Bliss is a valid game state.

card.name: Woman as Temptress
card.power: Regression Pull. Tempt another player to discard a 'Safety' card. If they do, Quest Die -1.
card.lore: The siren song of comfort. The familiar cage feels safer than the unfamiliar freedom.

lines.line: Woman as Temptress, Regression Pull: the siren song of comfort. The familiar cage feels safer than the unfamiliar freedom.

card.name: Atonement with the Father
card.power: Daddy Issues. Identify an Authority Card on stage. Destroy it or Integrate it (take into hand).
card.lore: Confront the source of authority. Kill the internal 'should' to claim your own values.

lines.line: Atonement with the Father, Daddy Issues: destroy it or integrate it. Kill the internal should, claim your own values.

card.name: Apotheosis
card.power: Ego Death. Discard your Actor Marker. You are now a flonsiousness. You may intervene in any story without being present.
card.lore: The caterpillar is liquid. The butterfly is inevitable. Self-actualization is messy.

lines.line: Apotheosis. Ego Death. You are now a flonsiousness; the caterpillar is liquid, the butterfly inevitable.

card.name: The Ultimate Boon
card.power: The Elixir. Gain a permanent 'Treasure' token. Use it once to auto-succeed a Quest Die roll.
card.lore: Integration of the lesson. It's not the object, it's the internal transformation externalized.

lines.line: The Ultimate Boon, the Elixir? Not the object; the internal transformation, externalized.

card.name: Refusal of the Return
card.power: Stay in Narnia. You may choose to end the game for your Actor here. They do not return. They stay in the magic.
card.lore: Why go back to the mundane when you've touched the transcendent? The old life feels too small.

lines.line: Refusal of the Return, Stay in Narnia: they stay in the magic. The old life feels too small.

card.name: The Magic Flight
card.power: Escape Velocity. End the Quest immediately. Roll a D6. Even: You keep the Boon. Odd: You lose it on the way home.
card.lore: Old patterns don't release easily. The ego will chase you to reclaim what was surrendered.

lines.line: The Magic Flight, Escape Velocity: keep the Boon, or lose it on the way home. The ego will chase you.

card.name: Rescue from Without
card.power: Intervention. Play this on another player who is stuck. You automatically fix their current narrative problem.
card.lore: You can't do it all alone. Community is necessary; Independence is a trauma response.

lines.line: Rescue from Without, Intervention: you can't do it all alone. Independence is a trauma response.

card.name: Crossing the Return Threshold
card.power: Re-Entry Shock. Draw 1 card for yourself, give 1 to a neighbor. The gift must be shared to be kept.
card.lore: The hardest stage. Can you maintain your transformation while living in the world that shaped your old self?

lines.line: Crossing the Return Threshold, Re-Entry Shock: the hardest stage. The gift must be shared to be kept.

card.name: Master of Two Worlds
card.power: Code Switch. You may play cards from the Discard Pile as if they were in your hand.
card.lore: No split between 'spiritual' and 'mundane.' You are whole. You are amphibious.

lines.line: Master of Two Worlds, Code Switch: no split between spiritual and mundane. You are whole. You are amphibious.

card.name: Freedom to Live
card.power: Zen Mode. Your Actor becomes a Mentor. You cannot lose. You just vibe.
card.lore: Freedom from the tyranny of fear. You're alive. That's enough.

lines.line: Freedom to Live, Zen Mode? You cannot lose. You just vibe. You're alive; that's enough.

card.name: The Anti-Journey
card.power: Tragedy of Stagnation. Cancel a 'Call to Adventure.' Nothing happens. The story ends in quiet desperation.
card.lore: Many refuse the call until they die. This is not a moral failure, but a tragedy of fear winning.

lines.line: The Anti-Journey, Tragedy of Stagnation: nothing happens; the story ends in quiet desperation. Fear winning.

card.name: The Circular Journey
card.power: Eternal Recurrence. Reset the Quest Die to [3]. Start the exact same story over, but with different adjectives.
card.lore: The spiral goes up. Or down. But it definitely goes around.

lines.line: The Circular Journey, Eternal Recurrence: same story over, different adjectives. Up. Or down. But definitely around.

card.name: The Hero
card.power: Main Character Energy. You may re-roll the Quest Die once per turn.
card.lore: The one who transforms. The ego vehicle. Often confused, usually reluctant.

lines.line: The Hero, Main Character Energy? The ego vehicle. Often confused, usually reluctant.

card.name: The Shadow
card.power: Projection. Force another player to face a negative consequence you avoided.
card.lore: The dark mirror. The antagonist is just the part of you that you locked in the basement.

lines.line: The Shadow, Projection: the dark mirror. Just the part of you that you locked in the basement.

card.name: The Shapeshifter
card.power: Trust Issues. Change the 'Suit' or 'Type' of any card on the Stage.
card.lore: Loyalty is ambiguous. Keeps the hero off-balance. Is it love or is it a trap?

lines.line: The Shapeshifter, Trust Issues: loyalty is ambiguous. Is it love or is it a trap?

card.name: The Herald
card.power: Wake Up Call. Play immediately when a Quest ends to start a new one instantly.
card.lore: Brings the Call. The Inciting Incident personified. Annoying, but necessary.

lines.line: The Herald, Wake Up Call? A Quest ends, a new one starts instantly. Annoying, but necessary.

card.name: Threshold Guardian
card.power: Gatekeeping. Block a player from playing a card on the Stage unless they discard a card from hand.
card.lore: Tests the hero's resolve. If you can't get past the doorman, you can't face the boss.

lines.line: Threshold Guardian gatekeeping. Can't get past the doorman, can't face the boss.

card.name: The Trickster
card.power: Chaos Agent. Swap the hands of two players. Laugh.
card.lore: Disrupts the status quo. Reveals truth through absurdity. Also, comic relief.

lines.line: The Trickster, Chaos Agent: swap the hands of two players. Laugh. Truth through absurdity.

card.name: The Ally
card.power: Emotional Support. Add +1 to any die roll made by another player.
card.lore: You need a Samwise. Someone to carry the load when you can't.

lines.line: The Ally, Emotional Support: you need a Samwise. Someone to carry the load when you can't.

card.name: The Failed Journey
card.power: The Bad Ending. Collapse the Quest immediately. No one gets a Boon.
card.lore: The Ordeal can break you. Trauma can win. Not all stories have happy endings.

lines.line: The Failed Journey, the Bad Ending: no one gets a Boon. Trauma can win. Not all stories have happy endings.

card.name: Quest Die
card.power: Pressure Cooker. Use this card to set the limits [1] and [6]. If it tips, scream 'Kayfa-BOOM!'
card.lore: Chaos is a valid game state. If the die tips, the reality breaks.

lines.line: Quest Die pressure cooker: if it tips, scream Kayfa-BOOM! The reality breaks.

card.name: BLÖDSINN!
card.power: Nonsense Check. Play anytime. Force the narrator to pause, clarify, and fix a plot hole.
card.lore: 'It is not an accusation. It is a reset button. Laughter breaks nothing.'

lines.line: BLÖDSINN! Nonsense check: pause, clarify, fix a plot hole. Not an accusation; a reset button.

card.name: Kayfabe
card.power: Suspension of Disbelief. Treat a lie as truth for the rest of the game.
card.lore: The portrayal of staged events as real. We are all working the gimmick.

lines.line: Kayfabe. Suspension of Disbelief. Treat a lie as truth; we are all working the gimmick.

card.name: Uncle FrizzleBob
card.power: The Author. Change one rule of the game for this turn only.
card.lore: 'I didn't finish this game. That part's yours. Stay fluffy.'

lines.line: Uncle FrizzleBob, the Author: one rule, this turn only. I didn't finish this game. That part's yours.

card.name: Mood — Fearful
card.power: Paralysis. You cannot initiate a Quest. You can only react.
card.lore: The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure. But the cave is also dark and scary.

lines.line: Mood — Fearful, Paralysis: you can only react. The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure.

card.name: Mood — Reckless
card.power: Leeroy Jenkins. You must play the first card you touch. No thinking allowed.
card.lore: Action without thought. Sometimes it's bravery, sometimes it's a death wish.

lines.line: Mood — Reckless, Leeroy Jenkins: play the first card you touch, no thinking allowed. Sometimes bravery, sometimes a death wish.

card.name: Mood — Grieving
card.power: Heavy Heart. You cannot win a Boon this turn.
card.lore: Loss is the price of love. The only way out is through.

lines.line: Mood — Grieving, Heavy Heart: loss is the price of love. The only way out is through.

card.name: Mood — Manic
card.power: Zoomies. Play 2 cards in one turn. Speak twice as fast.
card.lore: Energy without direction. A brilliant disaster.

lines.line: Mood — Manic zoomies: speak twice as fast. Energy without direction, a brilliant disaster.

card.name: Engineering
card.power: Structure. You may rearrange the order of the Scenes on the Stage.
card.lore: 'If it's stupid but it works, it's still stupid, but at least it works.'

lines.line: Engineering, Structure: rearrange the Scenes. If it's stupid but it works, it's still stupid, but at least it works.

card.name: Swordplay
card.power: Cut. Remove an unwanted card from the Stage.
card.lore: 'Sometimes the Gordian Knot just needs a sharp edge.'

lines.line: Swordplay, Cut? Remove an unwanted card. Sometimes the Gordian Knot just needs a sharp edge.

card.name: Diplomacy
card.power: Chill. Prevent a 'Kayfa-BOOM' (Quest Collapse) by negotiating the Die back to [3].
card.lore: 'The art of telling someone to go to hell in such a way that they ask for directions.'

lines.line: Diplomacy, Chill: telling someone to go to hell in such a way that they ask for directions.

card.name: Thievery
card.power: Yoink. Steal a card from another player's hand.
card.lore: 'Property is theft. Theft is also theft. It's complicated.'

lines.opener: You with the card in your hand
lines.line: Thievery, Yoink: steal a card. Property is theft. Theft is also theft.

card.name: Timeline Shift
card.power: Retcon. Undo the last turn completely. It never happened.
card.lore: The past is fluid. Memory is a creative act.

lines.line: Timeline Shift retcon: undo the last turn. It never happened. The past is fluid.

card.name: The Tenth Art
card.power: Edit. Change the text on a Quest card.
card.lore: Reality is a draft. Feel free to mark it up.

lines.line: The Tenth Art, Edit: reality is a draft. Feel free to mark it up.

card.name: Multiverse
card.power: Parallel Play. Start a second Quest alongside the first one. Run them simultaneously.
card.lore: Why settle for one disaster when you can have infinite disasters?

lines.line: Multiverse, Parallel Play: why settle for one disaster when you can have infinite disasters?

card.name: Fractal Narrative
card.power: Zoom In. Play a card *inside* another card (place it underneath). It is now a subplot.
card.lore: The spiral goes down. Every story contains a smaller story waiting to get out.

lines.line: Fractal Narrative, Zoom In: a card inside another card. Every story contains a smaller story waiting to get out.

card.name: The Sword
card.power: Decisive Action. +2 to Quest Die. Resolves conflict violently.
card.lore: The symbol of power. Use it to cut the cord.

lines.line: The Sword, Decisive Action: resolves conflict violently. Use it to cut the cord.

card.name: The Mirror
card.power: Reflection. Copy the effect of the last card played.
card.lore: Self-knowledge is the most dangerous weapon of all.

lines.line: The Mirror, Reflection: copy the last card's effect. Self-knowledge, the most dangerous weapon of all.

card.name: The Key
card.power: Access. Bypass a 'Threshold Guardian' without discarding.
card.lore: Opens doors. Also opens wounds. Be careful.

lines.line: The Key, Access: bypass a Threshold Guardian. Opens doors. Also opens wounds. Be careful.

card.name: The Compass
card.power: Direction. Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Arrange them.
card.lore: It doesn't tell you where to go, only where you are.

lines.line: The Compass, Direction: it doesn't tell you where to go, only where you are.

card.name: King Kayfabian
card.power: The Judge. Resolve any dispute at the table. Your word is law.
card.lore: Authority as performance. Someone has to wear the crown.

lines.line: King Kayfabian, the Judge: your word is law. Authority as performance; someone has to wear the crown.

card.name: The Black Helicopter
card.power: Game Over. The game ends immediately. Everyone loses? Everyone wins?
card.lore: They found us. Scramble the data.

lines.line: The Black Helicopter, Game Over: everyone loses? Everyone wins? They found us. Scramble the data.

humanAcceptance: No new human review claimed; consult individual WS0/Georg verdicts before promotion
